hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: One-time pool initialization and liquidity gate hook that selectively blocks sell-direction swaps (token1→token0) for addresses not in an owner-managed allowlist when a per-token flag is set, while buy-direction swaps always succeed. Anyone can call tokenSet() to activate the sell restriction at any time. Only the deployer's tx.origin is initially allowlisted.
